description: The self-explaining check runs in CI and in lint, but the Stage 3 executor does not run it before it pushes, and the prompts name only the lint task. Six of six pull requests ignored the rule, and each violation cost a CI run and a review iteration.
goal: Make the Stage 3 executor run scripts/check_self_explaining.py in its pre-push step in sandbox_executor/entrypoint/executor/pre_push.py, so a change that adds a docstring or an explanatory comment fails in the executor turn before the push, and the failure output names the offending files and lines so the executor agent can fix them. Add one sentence to holon-config/prompts/executor.template.md telling the executor that the check runs before push. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Failing in the executor turn removes the pipeline run and review iteration each violation costs today.
acceptance_criteria: The gate runs in the executor turn before push (Stage 3), not only in CI.

A test in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_pre_push_self_explaining.py drives the pre-push step in apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/entrypoint/executor/pre_push.py against a real temporary git repository whose branch adds a Python docstring, and asserts the step reports failure and the output names the file and line of the docstring, with no push attempted.
The same test file asserts the step succeeds on a branch that adds only code and a '# why:' comment.
A test in the same file asserts holon-config/prompts/executor.template.md still renders and states that the self-explaining check runs before push.

**The review already tells flows the rule (engineering-rules item 18), and 6 of 6 PRs ignored it**, so the gate must run in Stage 3 before the push (pre-push), not only in CI, or each violation costs a pipeline run plus a review iteration (churn under the end-state rule).
All tests pass via 'uv run pytest' and 'uv run task lint' passes.
